root.label: Iran Strait of Hormuz bill advances October 2 2026

events.label: Iran Strait of Hormuz bill advances October 2 2026

slots.name: legislative status
slots.sentence: Iran's parliament has completed a committee-level consideration of a proposed bill that would establish what lawmakers frame as the future Iranian management of the Strait of Hormuz, including the imposition of fees on commercial vessels using the vital waterway.
